sn12.52:1.2: Upādāniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavāḍḍhati ||
sn12.52:1.7: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 3
sn12.52:2.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave dasannaṃ vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ vīsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ tiṃsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ cattārīsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānaṃ mahā aggikkhandho jāleyya ||
sn12.52:2.2: Tatra puriso kālena kālaṃ sukkhāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhippeyya || sukkhāni ca gomayāni pakkhippeyya || sukkhāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhippeyya ||
sn12.52:2.3: Evañhi so bhikkhave mahā aggikkhando tadāhāro tadupādāno ciram dīgham addhānam jaleyya || 4
sn12.52:2.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave upādāniyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati ||
sn12.52:2.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 5
sn12.52:3.1: Upādāniyesu bhikkhave dhammesa ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati ||
sn12.52:3.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 6
sn12.52:4.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave dasannaṃ vā kaṭṭhavāhānam vīsāya vā || tiṃsāya vā cattārīsāya vā kaṭṭhavāhānam mahā aggikkhandho jāleyya ||
sn12.52:4.2: tatra puriso na kālena kālaṃ sukkhāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhippeyya || na sukkhāni ca gomayāni pakkhippeyya || na sukkhāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhippeyya ||
sn12.52:4.3: Evañhi so bhikkhave mahā aggikkhandho purimassa ca upādānassa pariyādānā aññāssa ca anupāhārā anāhāro nibbāyeyya || || 7
sn12.52:4.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave upādāniyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati ||
sn12.52:4.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || ||
